overall.verdict: Calm indigo dark chrome and the Hub One split bar are close to shipping, but the 1px=$50 law is only true on Account and Settings—Home, Activity, Receive and Swap draw badge-length bars or empty decorations. Desktop two-column is used on Pay and Settings and abandoned as a short left stack plus empty well everywhere else.
priority_fixes: Enforce one scale: Home USDC bar, Hub One send/receive, Pay/Swap overlays, Activity money rows all at Settings 1px=$50 with edge fade—not per-card auto-fit.
Home: delete the On-chain/Reserve/Accounts numeric legend; let Instant send/receive caption the total; fill the left column so it matches ACCOUNTS+RECENT.
Receive/Swap: stop showing 0.00 as a value; Receive uses inbound-room bar for requested amount; Swap CTA states Place order and never paints a fake quote.
Activity: bars only on money, inspector shows Δ+proof not a restated row; do not ship 07 and 08 as duplicates.
Pay/Receipt: one bilateral bar (Before/After only); drop 2004 ms and the broken This payment tick; Frame #40 + copyable proof as the trust object.
